target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Multi-arts nonprofit with year-round programming, rotating monthly gallery exhibits, and established artist network. Commission platform would streamline artist submissions and connect exhibiting artists with buyers seeking custom work.

actual_brand_research.artist_focus: Local, regional, and national artists across multiple disciplines
actual_brand_research.visual_style: Community arts center — approachable, creative, professional

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: Commission Custom Art from Local Artists
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The digital commission platform for Ashtabula Arts Center — connecting art lovers with local artists for custom portraits, landscapes, and regional artwork inspired by Ashtabula County's scenic beauty.

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Gallery showcase of local artist work with Ashtabula County scenic backdrop
visual_direction.color_scheme: Warm earth tones with creative accent colors
visual_direction.photography_style: Artist portraits at work, completed commissions, regional scenery inspiration

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with Ashtabula Arts Center's community arts mission

Secure messaging between clients and artists
differentiators_based_on_research: Connection to established arts center reputation
Multi-discipline artist network (visual arts, theater, music)
